question: "The Nice Guy Who Finished First" is the biography of which famous sportsperson?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rahul Dravid.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• "The Nice Guy Who Finished First" is a biography of **Rahul Dravid.**
 
• The book was authored by **Devendra Prabhudesai.**
 
• Rahul Dravid is an Indian former International cricketer and a batsman.
 
• His nickname is 'The Great Wall', 'Mr. Dependable'.
 
• He got Padma Bhsuhan (2013), Padma Sri (2004), Arjuna Award (1998).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **David Beckham** is an English former professional footballer, the current president & co-owner of Inter Miami CF and the co-owner of Salford City.
 
• **Michael Phelps** belongs to the United States of America.
 
 
• He is also known as the "Flying Fish" or "The Baltimore Bullet".
 
• He is one of the most celebrated Sportsperson in the Olympic games ever with rewards of approximately two dozen Gold medals.
 
 
 
• **Tiger Woods **is an American golfer.
 
 
• He holds the record for being World Number One for the most consecutive weeks as well as for the greatest total number of weeks.
